task.description: WF-02 step 02e (ORCH): operator commands for the login-directory pepper rotation tooling

result.summary: OPERATOR ACTION REFERENCE (no action is required until a rotation is planned). A deployed release container has NO Mix (verified on QA by infra T-0154), so the rotation tooling is called as plain public functions through the release rpc against the running node; wrap each call in IO.inspect so the result is printed (rpc sets no exit status; read the printed {:ok, ...} / {:error, atom}). Output is key ids and row counts only, never an email, an email key or a pepper. KEY STATUS: bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.KeyRotation.key_status() |> IO.inspect()'. BACKFILL (re-keying step): bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill.run(dry_run: true) |> IO.inspect()' then bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill.run() |> IO.inspect()'. RETIRE A KEY ID (irreversible deletion of that pepper's rows; refuses the current id and an absent id): dry run first, bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.KeyRotation.retire_key("OLD_ID", dry_run: true) |> IO.inspect()' then bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.KeyRotation.retire_key("OLD_ID") |> IO.inspect()'. Mix forms for dev/CI: mix letflow.login_directory.key_status, mix letflow.login_directory.retire_key --key-id OLD_ID [--dry-run], mix letflow.backfill_login_directory [--dry-run]. Full procedure (first provisioning, planned rotation, emergency rotation, rollback): docs/runbooks/login-directory-pepper-rotation.md. EXTERNAL: ai-dala-infra landscape/secrets-inventory.md needs entries for LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER and _PEPPER_ID per environment (not edited from here).
